model_id.title: Model id
model_id.description: HuggingFace sentence-similarity model, requested as POST {api_base_url}/models/{model_id}.

hf_token.title: HuggingFace token
hf_token.description: Sent as a bearer token. Write-only: it is masked when read back. Use ${env:HF_TOKEN} to keep it out of config.yml.

threshold.title: Confidence threshold
threshold.description: A guide channel is accepted when its best similarity score is at least this value.

batch_size.title: Batch size
batch_size.description: Most candidate names sent to the model in one request. A longer shortlist is split over several requests.

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: Root of the inference API. The default is the local mock of this example (mock/hf_api.py); use https://api-inference.huggingface.co for the real service.
